contribution.position: Reliability remains unproven under the exact failure mode this change touches. artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and artifact:perf-report (p99 within budget at peak load) are encouraging but neither exercises retry-storm conditions, and artifact:incident-log records two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms. Confidence in reliability still requires evidence that the queue change has been tested specifically under retry-storm behavior before this gap can be closed.
